description: This source file provides a collection of async and sync functions for managing video generation, content retrieval, remixing, listing, and status checking via the OpenAI API in a structured and extensible manner. It integrates with a custom handler, logging, and a provider configuration system, supporting both immediate and coroutine-based calls. It serves as a core module for interacting with video-related endpoints, with functions for generating videos, downloading content, remixing, listing, and fetching statuses.
